**Event:** Invited talk — "How Do Data Impact New Workplaces? A Data Scientist Perspective"\
**Location:** University of Bamberg, Germany

## Context

Drawing on both organizational research and applied data science practice, this talk
examined what actually distinguishes organizations that use data well from those that
merely collect it, and what that difference means for how workplaces are designed.
